dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: Accursed Shadow Realms... Don't they ever take a day off? We've got tons of work to do, and not enough hands to do it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do the Druzhna need to deal with the Shadow Realm...?

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: You may as well ask if winter is cold. Our duty is to ensure that all lands the Tsaritsa surveys are at peace.

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: The Shadow Realm is the antithesis of such, being a most unstable... disaster. We handle every report sent by the Energy Commission concerning this issue...

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: Alright, be about your business, then. Ah. Right. If you discover a Shadow Realm, please notify us in good time.

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: We Druzhna are not at liberty to scramble this way and that. The Commission, which spends its days traveling across Snezhnaya to maintain the Kresnik's Torches, is more nimble in this regard...

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: It does strike me as somewhat odd... It sometimes feels like they know something about the Shadow Realm...

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: But so long as they detect the Realms in time, that's good enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you usually handle the issue?

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: We organize search groups, and if they detect the Shadow Realm's energy core, they neutralize it. If not, they'll seal it off.

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: Most Shadow Realms disappear naturally over time... so there's no great disaster, so long as no one enters them by mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: It is our duty to serve.
